title: Synthesis, DNA Binding Properties, Molecular Docking and ADME Studies of Schiff Base Compound Containing Pyridine-Propargyl Group.
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过光谱、粘度及分子对接方法研究含吡啶-炔丙基席夫碱化合物与DNA的小沟槽结合，属于广义蛋白-DNA互作体系中的小分子-DNA结合，分子对接方法可迁移至TF-DNA界面建模，但对象非蛋白-DNA且深度有限。
abstract: The structure of the pyridine-based Schiff base compound containing the propargyl group was characterized by NMR spectroscopy. Binding of compound 2 with double-stranded fish sperm DNA (Fsds-DNA) was investigated using viscosity measurement studies and UV/VIS and fluorescence spectral techniques. Binding of compound 2 with Fsds-DNA results in minor hypochromism with no change in absorption maxima and fluorescence quenching with almost no shift in emission maxima, which can be attributed to the groove-binding mode of the interaction. The binding constant was found to be 4.7x10(4)  M(-1) . The Fsds-DNA viscosity measurement, KI quenching and NaCl quenching studies and the competitive interaction between compound 2 and ethidium bromide with DNA confirm the proposed binding mode. In addition, interactions between compound 2 and the DNA double helix were analysed by molecular docking study in order to determine the binding mode and binding affinity. As a result of molecular docking, the binding affinity of the 2-DNA complex, which has the most stable conformation -8.10 kcal/mol and it is located in its minor groove. In addition, molecular docking and ADME studies for compound 2 were also performed.
abstract_zh: 含炔丙基的吡啶基席夫碱化合物的结构通过核磁共振光谱进行了表征。化合物2与双链鱼精DNA（Fsds-DNA）的结合通过粘度测量研究以及紫外/可见光谱和荧光光谱技术进行了考察。化合物2与Fsds-DNA的结合导致轻微减色效应，吸收最大值无变化，荧光猝灭且发射最大值几乎无位移，这可归因于沟槽结合模式的相互作用。结合常数测定为4.7x10(4) M(-1)。Fsds-DNA粘度测量、KI猝灭和NaCl猝灭研究，以及化合物2与溴化乙锭对DNA的竞争性相互作用，证实了所提出的结合模式。此外，通过分子对接研究分析了化合物2与DNA双螺旋之间的相互作用，以确定结合模式和结合亲和力。分子对接结果显示，具有最稳定构象的2-DNA复合物的结合亲和力为-8.10 kcal/mol，且其位于DNA小沟中。另外，还进行了化合物2的分子对接和ADME研究。
